title: Rohan birthday gift
text: Noise-cancelling headphones from the store on Newbury Street. Lena is splitting the cost. Do not tell Rohan.

title: Saturday dinner
text: Neptune Oyster, table for four. Sam booked it. Lena may be late. No shellfish for Rohan.

title: Mum's visit
text: Mum stays 12 to 19 November. Spare keys are with Rohan. She wants to see the Gardner Museum.

title: Talk outline
text: Voice agents: latency budgets, floor control, and why tiers belong in code.

title: Northwind floor
text: Walk away below 12 percent discount. Keep this to the deal team.

title: Climbing
text: Muhammad has my harness. Ask him about the Red Rocks trip in March.
